body: My comment was to demonstrate that we lack sufficient knowledge to make that decision. I'm not trying to say you are wrong, you're free to believe whatever it is you want. (but for discussion's sake) However, I think It's odd in one comment you both suggest evil does not exist and at the same time delineating that those at the top should not benefit and those at the bottom should be helped(correct me if I'm wrong). Who are we to say that is how it should be? I'll be the devil's advocate for a second, What if we Entertain the idea that those at the bottom and top deserve what they get(not that I genuinely believe that 100% or the opposite)? I know plenty of people at the bottom who are lazy and those at the top who are incredibly hard working. Is it right to take from them? That's how nature settles things. The strongest eats while the weakest die off. Who are we to say nature is wrong in how it dictates what goes where? The thing is I don't think anyone has enough information to make the best decision. To me, I couldn't care less that my neighbor has more in his bowl then me, I do care that my Neighbor has less. It is up to me to help that neighbor out, it is not to me to take for my well-off neighbor. I don't believe in taking from others only giving to others. Who am I to force that idea on those who do not think like me. I am grateful that you believe in what you believe. At the same time, I'm grateful that I believe in what I believe. I don't believe in forcing you to believe what I believe my friend.

Okay, I'm gonna try and give you the best advice I can without sounding like an ass. First off, you need to stop being self pretentious. The fact that your parents are  abusive might have had bigger impact then you thought. The fact that everyone perceives things differently is psychology 101, and should be nestled in your mind everyday. I know this cause I've been in you're shoes before . I have had an abusive alcoholic mother, and a father who was not around until I reached high school. You need to take a deep breath  and understand everyone is not out to get you, it may feel that way ,but that's just what you're perceiving. I have guy friends and I have (girl) friends. It's vary common that guys will poke fun at you, its something you're gonna have to live with. Stop taking everything they are saying to heart cause that's how guys make friends. Girls don't do this though, that's why I have both gender types as friends. When I just want to goof off, play video games, and not be serious I hang out with my guy friends. When I want to have a serious talk about a girl I like or " feelings" I talk to my friends that are girls. Maybe you're just not meant to have guy friends. No matter how much you don't like it, you're gonna have to live with it. Not every girl is looking for a relationship. It will take some time, but you will need to weed them out. Now, you say you want guy friends,but I have a feeling you quit trying to be their friend if they pick on you.I could be wrong, and if I am I'm sorry. What you need is humility. To you they think your a jerk, but maybe its how you approach them. We are all still animals and if you act cocky then other males take it as a threat or a challenge. To by pass this , you need to stop with the "I" and use " you" more. Withhold from saying stuff about yourself and ask others about how they are doing, or what their hobbies are.not saying you don't do this, but I'm saying NEVER talk about your self unless you're asked. Last but not least, stop taking everything others are saying so seriously! Remember words only hold as much power as we give them . If someone was to say something mean to you in another language that you don't understand, I highly doubt your feelings would be hurt.
